news.title: A surprise: Inzaghi to lead Al-Hilal in the 2029 Club World Cup!
news.lede: The Italian coach has not renewed his contract so far. A Saudi journalist has dropped a major bombshell, confirming that Al-Hilal manager Simone Inzaghi will lead the Italian into the 2029 FIFA Club World Cup. Reports had suggested Al-Hilal's management put Inzaghi under observation to settle whether he would stay on, particularly after defeats to Neom in the Roshn League and Qatar's Al-Shamal in the AFC Champions League Elite. Saudi journalist Abdulaziz Al-Muraisel told "Nabd Tuwaiq" otherwise.

news.title: FIFA's legal head Garcia leaves as Infantino faces intense presidential re-election campaign
news.lede: GENEVA — FIFA’s top lawyer left the soccer body Friday after eight years working for its president Gianni Infantino and a men’s World Cup in North America with intense scrutiny on disciplinary rulings. “Emilio García Silvero has expressed his wish to embark on a new chapter in his career and return to Spain after 15 years of working abroad in the service of international football,” FIFA said in a statement. As head of FIFA’s legal and compliance unit, García oversaw tournament disciplinary cases, transfer market rules and contractual disputes worldwide, and steered moving the soccer body’s lawyers from Zurich to Miami in 2023. García also introduced greater transparency in FIFA legal work with more case documents and rulings published, including lists of which clubs are sanctioned from the global transfer market.

news.title: Nigeria vs Japan: Flamingos U-17 World Cup final preview
news.lede: Published on 6 Nov 2026 at 17:07 by Imhonlamhen. Nigeria’s Flamingos will face Japan on Saturday in the final of the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco. Akeem Busari’s team have become the first African nation to reach the final of the competition. They will now attempt to win the trophy for the first time in Nigeria’s history.

news.title: Spain could sensationally scrap 2030 World Cup hosting plans if Morocco is awarded the final
news.lede: A leading candidate to become Spain's next Prime Minister has threatened to withdraw the nation from co-hosting the 2030 World Cup if Morocco is awarded the final. Alberto Nunez Feijoo insists the showpiece event must be held in Spain, adding a major political twist to the ongoing venue debate. World Cup hosting threat Spain's role as a co-host for the 2030 World Cup could be in jeopardy. Feijoo, the leader of the conservative Partido Popular, has pledged to withdraw national support for the tournament if he is elected Prime Minister.Feijoo will only back the project if Spain is chosen to host the final instead of Morocco.

news.title: Argentina’s World Cup glory comes alive at Latin American Film Festival at CAP
news.lede: Messi's dream and Argentina's historic triumph take center stage; Football, tango and Latin American culture celebrated at Kuwait film festival through 'Muchachos' Argentina's historic triumph at the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar, the remarkable journey of football legend Lionel Messi and the unifying power of the game took centre stage at the Latin American Film Festival, with the screening of Muchachos: The People's Film at the Contemporary Art Platform (CAP) on November 5. Welcoming the audience, Argentina's Ambassador to Kuwait H.E. Ramiro Hernan Velloso said he was delighted to present the film as part of the festival, which was being organised in collaboration with the embassies of Argentina, Cuba, Mexico and Peru and hosted by CAP. The ambassador expressed appreciation to CAP for hosting the festival and said the organizers hoped it would become an annual tradition.

news.title: Portugal legend Cristiano Ronaldo announces retirement from international football
news.lede: In his 23 years on the national team, the 41-year-old forward scored 146 goals and won 234 caps, both men’s world records. Football superstar Cristiano Ronaldo announced in an Instagram video on Thursday that he was stepping down from the Portuguese national team. “A journey that began in August 2003 and changed my life forever has come to an end,” Ronaldo told his 679 million followers. Ronaldo’s farewell comes after criticism over his performance at the 2026 Fifa World Cup and a recent falling out with the national team’s new coach.
